claims.locator: PDF p.4, Section 2.1, Eq. (2) and following two paragraphs
claims.fact: One Dirac psi and one complex phi couple to the same D_mu=partial_mu+i e' V_mu. WIMP sector is SM singlet; SM fields are hidden neutral. V is the additional U(1)' connection, not independent vector matter.

claims.locator: PDF p.4, Eq. (2) discussion; Atlas declared R_SM template
claims.fact: The source explicitly couples this hidden sector to the SM. Expand the declared ordinary three-family SM baseline, including one Higgs doublet; do not import any additional RH neutrinos.

claims.locator: PDF p.4, common D_mu in Eq. (2); catalogue normalization
claims.fact: Source hidden unit is already q_psi=q_phi=1; shared primitive hypercharge rescaling over the complete source inventory is q=6Y. Dirac psi becomes two LH Weyl fields with hidden charges +1,-1.
